### 页面标题
- **EASi-HF Preserved” – Timelines Base Case vs Best Case**

### 表格（里程碑/时间）
表头：**Milestone｜Actual｜Base Case Planning｜Best Case Planning**

- Final Trial Design Outline｜**22-Nov-2023**
- Final Protocol｜**15-Mar-2024**
- Final CTA Package｜**18-Mar-2024**
- First Initiation Visit｜**31-May-2024**
- First Participant Screened｜**17-Jun-2024**
- First Participant Randomized｜**08-Jul-2024**
- Last Participant Randomized｜Base：**23-Jun-2026**｜Best：**19-Apr-2027***  
- Last Participant Completed｜Base：**22-May-2028**｜Best：**18-Jan-2028**
- Database Lock｜Base：**03-Jul-2028**｜Best：**29-Feb-2028**
- Key Results｜Base：**10-Jul-2028**｜Best：**07-Mar-2028**
- Final Clinical Trial Report｜Base：**28-Aug-2028**｜Best：**25-Apr-2028**

表格下方绿色文字：
- **4.1m base vs. best-case**

### 右侧要点（项目符号）
- **31-Aug-26:** Enrollment target of **6000** pts completed (~**2m** delay vs base case due to **EF ≥60% cap**)
- **01-Sep-26:** **HHF < 6m** enrollment cap start (during trial FU)

### 右下绿色说明框
- Longer enrollment period due to EF capping is expected to be offset by faster event accumulation, leading to an overall **~4-month acceleration**

### 脚注/假设（底部）
脚注：
- *Best case scenario includes ongoing recruitment of highest risk patients beyond 6000 randomized participants up until about 6 months before the projected start of the planned 3-month close-out period.*

假设：
- **Assumptions of base-case scenario:** Event rate for placebo: **7.7**
- Actual recruitment assumptions; Cap of **LVEF ≥60%** implemented **Jan 2026**, Cap on no prior HHF implemented **Nov 2027**

### 决定与行动项（仅基于可见内容）
- 页面未出现明确标注的“决定/Decisions”或“行动项/Action items”。仅包含时间计划、假设与说明。
